newsitem.title: LATVIA: RIGA SHIPYARD GETS FISHING-BOAT ORDER - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: RIGA SHIPYARD GETS FISHING-BOAT ORDER - REPORT.

text.p: The Riga Shipyard has received its first Norwegian order to build several small fishing-boats, the Dienas bizness newspaper reported on Tuesday.
The total investment needed for the contract amounts to $750,000, Vasilii Melnik, the company's president, is quoted as saying.
The boats will be 35-metres long and the cost to produce one will be 450,000 lats.
The Riga Shipyard earlier said its turnover in May came to three million dollars, a rise from $1.3 million in the first quarter of this year.
